title: Brokerage Rate Card: Commission, Transaction, Closing and Warranty Charges — In-Place Home Resale
content:
**In-Place Home Resale brokerage rate card.** The figures below are the commission terms and the charges taken at closing on each package. A package with a commission rate of 0.0 charges no commission and has no brokerage transaction fee.

| Package | Commission rate (percent of the gross sale price) | Minimum commission (USD) | Brokerage transaction fee (USD) | Closing fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Resale Approval Service | 0.0 | not applicable | not applicable | 150.00 |
| Owner-Marketed Listing Package | 0.0 | not applicable | not applicable | 150.00 |
| Assisted Resale Listing | 4.0 | 2500.00 | 295.00 | 195.00 |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage | 6.0 | 3500.00 | 295.00 | 195.00 |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus | 6.5 | 4500.00 | 295.00 | 195.00 |
| Guaranteed Resale Program | 6.0 | 3500.00 | 295.00 | 195.00 |

**Terms used on this card.**

- *Gross sale price* (the commission basis on every package): the contract price for the home, excluding any personal property itemized separately.
- *Closing fee*: the document preparation and title-transfer processing fee.
- *Transaction fee*: the brokerage transaction fee, carried only by the packages with brokerage.
- *Guaranteed purchase*: on every package the schedule marks the commission as waived when Hearthstone itself buys the home under the guarantee; the guarantee is offered only on the Guaranteed Resale Program.

## Buyer home warranty (12 months)

| Package | Warranty included | Price of the optional warranty the seller may buy (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Resale Approval Service | No | 495.00 |
| Owner-Marketed Listing Package | No | 495.00 |
| Assisted Resale Listing | No | 495.00 |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage | No | 495.00 |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus | Yes | not applicable (included) |
| Guaranteed Resale Program | Yes | not applicable (included) |

**Points of reading.** A home sold for 62000.00 with a separately itemized shed sold for 1500.00 has a gross sale price of 62000.00, the shed being personal property itemized separately (hypothetical figures). A seller on the Assisted Resale Listing who wants the buyer to have the warranty buys it at 495.00; a seller on the Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus has it included.
